hamiltonIsland.title: Whitsundays: Work, Reef & Sea Kayak
hamiltonIsland.summary: Use Hamilton Island as the work and homeschool base through Wednesday, then decide between the current reef-and-Whitehaven plan and a weather-approved three-day sea-kayak expedition. Keep the existing Sunday-to-Sunday window unless the chosen route cannot preserve a serious reef-snorkeling day.

arrival.title: Arrive and establish the base
items: Fly from Sydney directly if the 2027 schedule permits; otherwise connect through Brisbane.
Buy groceries, learn the buggy and shuttle system, and keep the day deliberately light.
Test property Wi-Fi, mobile backup, Starlink placement, the corporate VPN, and work / school zones.

departure.title: Connect through Brisbane to Longreach
items: Keep Saturday entirely on Hamilton Island and use Sunday morning there if flight timing allows.
Fly Hamilton Island → Brisbane → Longreach on one travel day, using Brisbane only as an airport connection.
Treat the same-day connection as a working assumption until the 2027 schedule confirms it.

base.recommendation: A two- or preferably three-bedroom Hamilton Island Holiday Home
base.reason: A holiday home offers a closable work area, kitchen, laundry, and enough separation for a 4:30 a.m. start.
requirements: A real door between the workspace and sleeping / living areas
Air conditioning and a desk or table for a laptop and portable monitor
Kitchen, laundry, existing Wi-Fi, and good mobile reception at the exact unit

A golf buggy included or reserved

workAfternoons: Catseye Beach swimming and beach sports

vacationDays.title: Whitehaven Beach and the Whitsunday Islands
vacationDays.plan: Choose a full-day sail / snorkel trip or a strong half-day Whitehaven trip. Prioritize Whitehaven and a Hill Inlet viewpoint if included; avoid an overloaded checklist itinerary.

vacationDays.title: Outer Great Barrier Reef
vacationDays.plan: Reserve a full day for a family-appropriate reef trip with snorkeling and interpretation. Treat this as weather-dependent and swap the two vacation days if operator advice favors it.

vacationDays.title: Hamilton Island Saturday
vacationDays.plan: Keep the whole day on Hamilton Island for beach, pool, buggy exploration, and an easy final island evening. This is a weekend day, so it extends the mini-vacation without using another workday.

cautions: October begins the commonly described marine-stinger season; follow current local advice and use stinger suits when recommended.
Confirm children's minimum ages, swimming expectations, seasickness precautions, shade, food, and cancellation terms.
Passage Peak is a challenging walk, not an automatic after-work stroll.

longreach.title: Outback Queensland: Work & Play
longreach.summary: Spend six nights in a functioning outback town rather than attempting a high-speed road loop. Longreach offers the airport, groceries, accommodation, museums, restaurants, pool, and tour operators needed for a credible work and homeschool base.

arrival.title: Fly in and establish the base
items: Fly from Brisbane to Longreach, collect a rental car, and buy groceries.
Settle into a two-bedroom base with a quiet air-conditioned workspace.
Test property Wi-Fi, mobile backup, Starlink placement, and work / school zones.

departure.title: Begin the trip to India
items: Fly Longreach → Brisbane and connect to the international itinerary the same day.
Use a protected through-ticket or leave a generous connection in Brisbane.
Travel overnight and arrive in India on Sunday, October 24.

base.recommendation: Saltbush Retreat two-bedroom house or cabin
base.reason: It combines a family configuration, kitchen, pool, Wi-Fi, outdoor space, and proximity to the two major museums.
base.backup: Longreach Motor Inn two-bedroom family room

Kitchen or strong kitchenette, laundry access, and a pool

vacationDays.title: Aviation and outback heritage
vacationDays.plan: Use a full day for the Qantas Founders Museum and Australian Stockman's Hall of Fame, with enough time for the strongest tours rather than treating both as quick stops.

vacationDays.title: Choose one defining outback day
vacationDays.plan: Option A is a long Winton dinosaur day. Option B is the best available Longreach station, stagecoach, or pioneer program. Prefer the Longreach option unless the Winton museums are a family priority.

cautions: Late October can be hot and some visitor experiences are seasonal; verify 2027 operating days before booking.
Do not use a remote station as the work base without independently confirmed power, connectivity, workspace, and cancellation terms.
Treat the Winton day as optional: it is a substantial drive, not a casual afternoon.
